concerns.text: FR-008 states the system must perform a sensitivity analysis on sparsity patterns and correlation coefficient k to validate robustness, but it does not define any measurable success criteria or verification threshold (e.g., acceptable performance delta, statistical test, or confidence interval). Without a concrete metric, the requirement is not verifiable.

FR-010 requires a warm‑up verification on a subset and a prediction of full‑scale runtime using an O(N²) scaling factor, yet it does not specify how the prediction accuracy will be assessed (e.g., allowed error margin, statistical confidence). The lack of a quantifiable check makes the requirement untestable.
